comments.author: Simon
comments.text:
FROM SIMON: 1. not far from = within walking distance of 2. came together = gathered 3. they created

promoted = they fostered 4. happy memories = fond memories 5. clear

lasting memories = vivid memories 6. stressful = nerve-racking

…

Good work yenth.

Note:

We don't say "I felt nerve-racking". Use 'nerve-racking' to describe the situation e.g. "it was a nerve-racking experience". Also, 'nerve-racking' is not exactly the same as 'stressful'. It's better for situations that make you feel nervous stress e.g. the feeling you have before performing in public.

comments.author: yenth
comments.text:
1\. not far from = within walking distance of

Every morning I go to work on foot because my office is within walking distance of my house

2\. came together = gathered

On the day of beginning a new term, pupils gathered at their schools to prepare for a new school-year.

3\. created/promoted = fostered

My sister fostered the love of music of her child.

4\. happy memories: fond memories

My child-hood is full of fond memories

5\. clear/lasting memories = vivid memories

One of my vivid memories in my youth was my first love.

6\. stressful = nerve-racking

Actually, I felt nerve-racking to finish this work on time
